notes.title: HOT FIX #3
notes.content:
One more hot fix, last one on this week.
[list]
[*] character's phrases now displayed correctly
[*] Habard is once again has a working UI.
[/list]
Also a note about future updates: we plan to update the game every week, gradually adding more content and mechanics, with hotfixes when necessary. Apart from special cases, we plan to do this on Friday evening (GMT).
